prompt: Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Build for this brief: A specialist shop; shoppers inspect objects, compare details and buy. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
